title: Launch Traffic Control playbook for multichannel announcements and release coordination
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Objective: Create a prescriptive playbook ("Launch Traffic Control") to coordinate blog, email, social, webinar, and release notes across product, design, engineering, growth, and support. The playbook must reduce misalignments during launch windows, provide a single schedule of record, and define escalation and fallback behaviors if a release slips or a regression is discovered.
acceptance_criteria: Single canonical launch schedule in the playbook covering UTC times and local launch windows for NA/EU/APAC
Pre-written release notes templates and blog/email/social copy blocks approved by PM and Design
Clear roll-forward/rollback decision tree and communication flows for engineering and support
Owner matrix mapping every asset (blog, email, social post, webinar invite, release notes) to a named owner and backup
Post-launch 48-hour monitoring checklist and reporting template included

notes: Key decisions: use staggered regional publishes with a canonical UTC schedule; maintain a single source-of-truth doc with embedded timeline and asset links. Escalation: if critical regression found within 24h of scheduled publish, shift to immediate rollback and trigger the rollback communication template in the playbook.
